title: SHIZUKU (GCOM-W1) Regular Observation Operations
document_revision: JAXA GCOM-W topics page, updated 2012-08-10; retrieved 2026-10-27

excerpts.text: JAXA completed the initial functional verification of the Global Change Observation Mission 1st - Water "SHIZUKU" (GCOM-W1) and has moved to the regular observation operation on August 10 as scheduled.
